title: What Is The Viral Hotel Lobby AI Trend?
key_facts: The viral 'Hotel Lobby' AI trend turns the performance of 'HOTEL LOBBY (Unc & Phew)' by Quavo and Takeoff on A COLORS SHOW (uploaded to YouTube on 17 Jun 2022) into a template.
AI edits swap in other pairs, from two cats to the Obamas, Elon Musk and Sam Altman, Messi and Ronaldo, and film and TV characters.
The format began spreading in September 2026 and ED Times says it has over 100 million total views across TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.
Quavo reposted the original on 23 Sep, calling it 'The Original'.
Takeoff was fatally shot on 1 Nov 2022 aged 28, according to reports by the Associated Press and BBC, which makes the AI recreations sensitive for many fans.
Quavo and singer Victoria Monet recreated the scene in person, Monet standing where Takeoff stood, captioned 'No AI', ahead of their album releases.
Reactions are split: some call the edits tasteless or overdone, others are glad the song is getting attention.
The article cites unnamed legal experts and unions on unclear posthumous rights, and mentions Tennessee's ELVIS Act and the proposed federal NO FAKES Act.
quote_evidence: The format began spreading rapidly across social media in September 2026, generating over 100 million total views across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts as individual edits went viral.
Takeoff (Kirsnick Khari Ball) was fatally shot on November 1, 2022, at the age of 28, according to reports by the Associated Press and BBC.
why_it_matters_hint: A viral AI format raises the question of AI copies of a performer who has died.
event_date: Trend since Sep 2026; article published 13 Oct 2026
notes: Full text read. The 100 million views figure and the legal comments are ED Times's own, with no named source. The article lists BBC, Associated Press and Complex under Sources. Ongoing trend, so freshness NEW with the start in the summary. Handled respectfully: it involves a man who has died.
